demos.name: ImageAvatars
demos.description: Image avatars can be created by passing standard img props src or srcSet to the component.

demos.name: LetterAvatars
demos.description: Avatars containing simple characters can be created by passing a string as children.

demos.name: BackgroundLetterAvatars
demos.description: You can use different background colors for the avatar.

demos.name: SizeAvatars
demos.description: You can change the size of the avatar with the height and width CSS properties.

demos.name: IconAvatars
demos.description: Icon avatars are created by passing an icon as children.

demos.name: VariantAvatars
demos.description: If you need square or rounded avatars, use the variant prop.

demos.name: FallbackAvatars
demos.description: - the provided children - the first letter of the alt text - a generic avatar icon

demos.name: GroupAvatars
demos.description: AvatarGroup renders its children as a stack.

demos.name: TotalAvatars
demos.description: If you need to control the total number of avatars not shown, you can use the total prop.

demos.name: CustomSurplusAvatars
demos.description: The renderSurplus prop is useful when you need to render the surplus based on the data sent from the server.

demos.name: Spacing
demos.description: You can change the spacing between avatars using the spacing prop.

body.text:
function Spacing() {
  return (
    <Stack spacing={4}>
      <AvatarGroup spacing="medium">
        <Avatar alt="Remy Sharp" src="/static/images/avatar/1.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Travis Howard" src="/static/images/avatar/2.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Cindy Baker" src="/static/images/avatar/3.jpg" />
      </AvatarGroup>
      <AvatarGroup spacing="small">
        <Avatar alt="Remy Sharp" src="/static/images/avatar/1.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Travis Howard" src="/static/images/avatar/2.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Cindy Baker" src="/static/images/avatar/3.jpg" />
      </AvatarGroup>
      <AvatarGroup spacing={24}>
        <Avatar alt="Remy Sharp" src="/static/images/avatar/1.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Travis Howard" src="/static/images/avatar/2.jpg" />
        <Avatar alt="Cindy Baker" src="/static/images/avatar/3.jpg" />
      </AvatarGroup>
    </Stack>
  );
}

demos.name: BadgeAvatars

body.text:
function BadgeAvatars() {
  return (
    <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
      <StyledBadge
        overlap="circular"
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
        variant="dot"
      >
        <Avatar alt="Remy Sharp, online" src="/static/images/avatar/1.jpg" />
      </StyledBadge>
      <Badge
        overlap="circular"
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
        badgeContent={2}
        color="primary"
      >
        <Avatar
          alt="Travis Howard, 2 unread messages"
          src="/static/images/avatar/2.jpg"
        />
      </Badge>
      <Badge
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'right' }}
        badgeContent={<SmallAvatar alt="" src="/static/images/avatar/1.jpg" />}
      >
        <InsertDriveFileIcon
          color="action"
          fontSize="large"
          titleAccess="Q4 budget spreadsheet, last edited by Remy Sharp"
        />
      </Badge>
    </Stack>
  );
}
